screen.index_lead: Follow the times you booked with our team.
screen.index_empty_lead: When you book a time with the team, it shows up in this list.
screen.new_lead: Pick the service and the day, see the free times and reserve yours.
screen.pick_hint: Pick the service and the day to see the free times.
screen.no_times: No free time on this day. Try another day.
screen.no_services: The team is not taking bookings right now.
screen.note_hint: Optional. Tell the team what it needs to know before the visit.
screen.payment_after: This service is paid. The time is held for a while and only confirmed after payment.
screen.service_note_paid: Takes about :minutes minutes. Paid in advance.
screen.awaiting_payment_lead: The time is held for you until
screen.hold_expired: The payment window is over and the time was released. Make a new booking.
screen.change_closed: The visit is a few hours away, so the time can no longer be changed here. Talk to the team.
screen.reschedule_lead: Pick another time. The payment and the protocol stay valid. Current time:
screen.team_index_lead: The bookings of every space, latest first.
screen.team_search: Search by protocol, customer, service or item
screen.team_index_empty_lead: Adjust the search, the day or the filters.
screen.team_note_hint: Only the team sees this note. The customer never receives it.
screen.team_reschedule_lead: The team can book outside the working hours. Only closed days and full times are refused.
screen.release_lead: Courtesy: the time is secured without a payment. The reason is recorded.
screen.services_lead: What the team does, how long it takes and whether it asks for a payment. The price belongs to the system's catalogue.
screen.services_empty_lead: Add a service so customers can book it.
screen.service_lead: The key identifies the service in the system and is never shown to the customer.
screen.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. E.g. reconfiguracao.
screen.duration_hint: In minutes, from 5 to 480. It is how long the time is held.
screen.requires_payment_hint: The booking waits for the payment before it secures the time.
screen.active_hint: Inactive services stay on the bookings already made and take no new ones.
screen.delete_service_confirm: Delete this service? Bookings already made stay.
screen.hours_lead: The periods of the week when the team takes bookings. A day can have several.
screen.hours_empty_lead: Without hours, no day has a free time.
screen.hour_lead: Pick the weekday and the period, in local time.
screen.closures_lead: Periods when the team takes no bookings, such as holidays.
screen.closure_lead: No free time is offered inside the period. Bookings already made do not change.

validation.key_format: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
validation.key_taken: A service with that key already exists.
validation.hour_order: The end has to be after the start.
validation.hour_overlap: That period overlaps another one on the same day.
validation.closure_order: The end has to be after the start.
validation.subject: That item cannot be used.
validation.slot_taken: That time is not available any more. Pick another.
validation.change_closed: The visit is a few hours away. Talk to the team.
validation.not_changeable: This booking can no longer be changed.
validation.not_confirmable: Only a booking with its time secured, and not yet started, can be confirmed.
validation.not_awaiting: Only a booking awaiting payment can be released.
validation.not_completable: Only a booking with its time secured can be completed.
validation.not_no_show: An absence can only be marked after the time of the visit.
